description: This line plot compares the Macro-F1 scores for two conditions—“MATTER (ours)” and “w/o material information”—across varying numbers of tokens. The x-axis, labeled “Number of tokens,” uses a linear scale ranging from 0.6 to 1.4, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The y-axis, labeled “Macro-F1 Score (%)”, uses a linear scale from 48 to 58, with tick marks at intervals of 2. The “MATTER (ours)” condition is represented by a pink line with circular markers and a solid line, starting at approximately 55% Macro-F1 Score at x=0.6, rising to a peak of 58% at x=1.0, and then declining to 50% at x=1.3. The “w/o material information” condition is represented by a purple line with circular markers and a dashed line, beginning at 52.5% at x=0.6, peaking at 56% near x=0.7, and then stabilizing around 50% for the remainder of the range. Shaded regions around each line indicate variance, with significant overlap between the two conditions near x=1.2.
caption_used: Comparison of Macro-F1 scores for MATTER and w/o material knowledge during tokenization training across different numbers of tokens. The pink line representing MATTER (ours) starts at approximately 55% Macro-F1 Score, peaks at 58% near x=1.0, and ends at 50% near x=1.3, showing a consistent decline after its peak. The purple line, representing w/o material information, begins at 52.5%, peaks at 56% near x=0.7, and then stabilizes around 50% for the remainder of the range. The shaded areas indicate variance, with significant overlap between the two conditions near x=1.2. The results suggest that MATTER consistently outperforms the alternative across all token counts, with a sharper decline in performance at higher token counts for both conditions.
